court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Civil Judge, Senior Division, Pune (Marriage Petition No.321/2017)
case_name: Mrs. Pooja Sandeep Dulgaj @ Miss. Pooja ... vs Mr Sandeep Ramkishan Dulgaj
facts_of_case: The applicant/wife is seeking transfer of Marriage Petition No.321/2017 pending before the Civil Judge, Senior Division, Pune to the learned Family Court, Thane.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that the transfer of the case is justified.
legal_principles.held: Miss Chandnani, learned advocate for respondent, submits that she requires one week's time. She does not oppose the transfer but seeks a brief adjournment.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case under Section 24 of the C.P.C. if it is justified.
legal_principles.held: By this application u/s 24 of the C.P.C., the applicant/wife is seeking transfer of Marriage Petition No.321/2017 pending before learned Civil Judge, Senior Division, Pune u/s 13 (1)(ia) (ib) of Hindu Marriage Act 1955, for dissolution of marriage, to learned Family Court, Thane.

outcome.final_order: Two weeks time before the Court at Pune was permitted by consent.

use_for_drafting: practical tips for family court cases
